record: National Museum of Singapore building account
facts: Designed by Henry Edward McCallum and opened in 1887. The 27 metre rotunda uses zinc fish-scale tiles with eight upper Corinthian columns. Doric and Ionic pilasters order the wings.

record: Singapore Urban Redevelopment Authority National Monument record
facts: The preserved monument is at 93 Stamford Road.
The preserved Stamford Road monument and the modern addition are distinct building sections.
